card-1.name: parking permit
card-1.desc: The residents' parking permit for the car runs out on {{date:2026-10-05|%A, %B %-d, %Y}}. Renew it on the city portal before then -- need the car registration and a recent utility bill as proof of address.

card-2.name: Drop off the donation bags at the Eastside thrift store
card-2.desc: Three bags of kids' clothes in the hall closet. The store's autumn clothing drive closes on the due date.
